version_channel_policy.edge_or_preview_policy: A newer upstream version is a candidate only after exact source, checksum, license, dependency closure, source-build, optimization, semantic route, ABI, and target execution evidence are captured. A channel label alone is never activation evidence.
version_channel_policy.three_preview_policy: Maintain up to three explicitly pinned preview candidates per lane only where authoritative upstream source and licensing permit acquisition. Do not fabricate preview versions for projects that do not publish them.

failure_closed_behavior: No source candidate may be selected by the repository-built dispatch manifest before target proof.
No ambient Termux Node, Java, or JNI library fallback is permitted.
Missing bootstrap JDK, dependency, compiler, ELF, ABI, symbol, link, or execution evidence keeps the affected lane TARGET_BUILD_PENDING.
Upstream licenses and notices remain authoritative.
